wizards.name: Magister Thessaly Vorne
wizards.text: A high mage of the old imperial schools who copies spells out of half-burned folios. She sells what she writes, and never says where the folios came from.

wizards.name: Oszkar Hedgefire
wizards.text: An elementalist who keeps Thornwatch's hedge-fires burning without wood. Travellers pay him for wands; the village pays him not to leave.

wizards.name: Widow Hask
wizards.text: A necromancer who lives in a stilt house over the bog and buys bones by the sack. Her scrolls smell of peat and grave-wax.
